user.title: Settlement
user.description: Outage schedules of DTEK Kyiv Regional Electric Networks (Kyiv region). Choose your address the same way as on dtek-krem.com.ua; start typing to search.

data_description.settlement: City, town or village, e.g. "м. Бориспіль".

data_description.street: Villages without street names have "Без вулиці".

data_description.house: As listed by DTEK, e.g. "43", "8 а" or "1/2".
data_description.name: Leave empty to use the address.

group.title: Group
group.description: DTEK does not name exactly one group for {settlement}, {street}, {house} (listed: {groups}). Choose the group whose schedule to follow; the DTEK website shows it after you enter the address.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to DTEK. Submit again to retry.
error.unknown_settlement: Choose a settlement from the list.
error.unknown_street: Choose a street from the list.
error.unknown_house: Choose a house from the list.
error.no_houses: DTEK lists no houses for this street. Submit again to retry.

data.show_possible: Show possible outages in the calendar

data_description.update_interval: Minutes between requests to DTEK (at least 2).
data_description.warning_minutes: Minutes before a scheduled outage to send the "outage_warning" event. 0 turns warnings off.
data_description.use_mirror: When DTEK can't be reached, take the schedule from the public mirror github.com/Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.
data_description.show_possible: Fill days without an actual schedule with the weekly schedule of possible outages.

entry_not_found.message: No DTEK KREM Outages entry with ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: DTEK KREM Outages entry {entry_id} is not loaded.

no_loaded_entries.message: No DTEK KREM Outages entries are loaded.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetches the schedule and the address status now.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: Entry to refresh. Leave empty to refresh all entries.

get_schedule.name: Get schedule
get_schedule.description: Returns the stored schedule by day, the weekly schedule of possible outages and the outage reported for the address.

config_entry_id.name: Entry
config_entry_id.description: Entry to read. Leave empty to return all entries.
